selection.description: Per domain, a 2x2 stratification over conversation depth and cross-service reach: the shortest and the longest single-service case, then the shortest and the longest case that also involves an auxiliary mock service. Ties break on the lowest numeric external id. Computed from turn count and involved_classes only, both of which are runner-visible, so the rule discloses nothing the runner may not already see.
selection.review_note: Reviewed for the first local checkpoint. One case per domain, taken as the single-service shallowest stratum of the reviewed demo suite, so the checkpoint set is a strict subset of the demo set and proves the runner, adapter, golden target, and artifact path on the least complex case available in each domain.
